title: Horton 'Never Give Up': Urchin, Possession, Council Room

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Annotated online game log with Horton's commentary

quality_note: One online game; Horton's pre-game plan plus commentary on his and his opponent's mistakes. The Possession lock won, but the opponent was ahead most of the game and resigned.
edition: First-edition Pearl Diver and Explorer. Hermit, Forum, Merchant Guild and Possession use pre-errata rules (Hermit then trashed itself for a Madman when you bought no cards; Possession's tokens went to the possessed player).
